nl: The database moved: change the address of db.internal.example.com in etc/hosts to 203.0.113.6.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/hosts'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('203.0.113.5 db.internal') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('203.0.113.5 db.internal', '203.0.113.6 db.internal'))
EOF
